stem: If \(3(2x - 5) = 4(x + 1)\), what is the value of \(x\)?

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the result of distributing 4 with the wrong sign, \(4x - 4\) instead of \(4x + 4\): \(2x = 11\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the value of \(2x\), not \(x\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the result of a sign slip when moving \(-15\) to the right side: \(2x = -19\).

verify:
x = symbols('x')
s = solve(Eq(3*(2*x - 5), 4*(x + 1)), x)[0]
assert s == Rational(19, 2)
assert value(choices[answer]) == s
assert all(value(choices[k]) != s for k in choices if k != answer)
